metadata.name: FuelUp Evidence Database
metadata.license: Data citations remain subject to their source terms
metadata.disclaimer: Educational evidence index only; not medical or dietetic advice.

records.title_en: 2023 IOC consensus statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs)
records.title_zh: 2023年國際奧會（IOC）關於運動相對能量不足（REDs）之共識聲明
records.intervention_studied: No intervention tested; synthesizes REDs pathophysiology, health/performance consequences, screening (REDs CAT2) and risk-management model across sports and sexes
records.study_design_sample: IOC expert working group consensus synthesizing the REDs mechanistic and clinical literature (no single primary sample)

records.title_en: American College of Sports Medicine Joint Position Statement: Nutrition and Athletic Performance
records.title_zh: 美國運動醫學會（ACSM）聯合立場聲明：營養與運動表現
records.journal_organization: Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise (joint ACSM / Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics / Dietitians of Canada statement)
records.intervention_studied: No intervention tested; provides reference ranges for energy, macronutrient, fluid and micronutrient needs for athletes
records.study_design_sample: Joint expert position statement synthesizing the sports nutrition evidence base (no single primary sample)

records.title_en: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: Protein and Exercise
records.title_zh: 國際運動營養學會（ISSN）立場聲明：蛋白質與運動
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes dose, timing and source of protein intake for muscle protein synthesis and adaptation
records.study_design_sample: ISSN expert position stand synthesizing protein-and-exercise RCT/meta-analysis literature (mostly adult samples)

records.title_en: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: Nutrient Timing
records.title_zh: 國際運動營養學會（ISSN）立場聲明：營養攝取時機
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes timing of carbohydrate/protein intake relative to exercise bouts
records.study_design_sample: ISSN expert position stand synthesizing nutrient-timing RCT literature (predominantly adult samples)

records.title_en: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: Safety and Efficacy of Creatine Supplementation in Exercise, Sport, and Medicine
records.title_zh: 國際運動營養學會（ISSN）立場聲明：肌酸補充於運動與醫學的安全性與效果
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; reviews safety/efficacy data on oral creatine monohydrate supplementation
records.study_design_sample: ISSN expert position stand synthesizing creatine RCT literature (predominantly adult samples)

records.title_en: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: Tactical Athlete Nutrition
records.title_zh: 國際運動營養學會（ISSN）立場聲明：戰術型工作者（軍警消）營養
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes energy, hydration, and recovery nutrition needs for occupational tactical populations
records.study_design_sample: ISSN expert position stand on nutrition for military/law-enforcement/firefighter ("tactical") populations, not sport athletes

records.title_en: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: Nutritional Concerns of the Female Athlete
records.title_zh: 國際運動營養學會（ISSN）立場聲明：女性運動員的營養議題
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes menstrual-cycle, RED-S, iron, and energy-availability considerations specific to female athletes
records.study_design_sample: ISSN expert position stand synthesizing female-athlete nutrition literature (mostly adult women; some adolescent discussion)

records.title_en: American College of Sports Medicine Position Stand: Exercise and Fluid Replacement
records.title_zh: 美國運動醫學會（ACSM）立場聲明：運動與水分補充
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes fluid/electrolyte balance physiology and hydration strategy recommendations around exercise
records.study_design_sample: ACSM expert position stand synthesizing hydration/fluid-balance exercise physiology literature (predominantly adult samples)

records.title_en: Promotion of Healthy Weight-Control Practices in Young Athletes
records.title_zh: 在年輕運動員中促進健康的體重控制行為
authors: Martin TJ; Council on Sports Medicine and Fitness (LaBella CR
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; provides clinical guidance on safe weight management and red flags for disordered eating/RWL in youth sport
records.study_design_sample: AAP clinical report synthesizing pediatric sports-medicine and eating-disorder literature (adolescent-specific)

records.title_en: Scientific Opinion on Dietary Reference Values for Water
records.title_zh: 關於水分飲食參考值之科學意見
records.intervention_studied: No intervention tested; sets total-water adequate-intake reference values by age/sex for the general (non-athlete) European population
records.study_design_sample: Regulatory scientific opinion synthesizing water-balance and hydration research for the general population, including reference values by age group

records.title_en: Role of Nutrition Education in Preventing Low Energy Availability Among Adolescent Female Athletes: A Scoping Review
records.title_zh: 營養教育在預防青少年女性運動員低能量可用性中的角色：範圍式回顧
records.intervention_studied: Nutrition education interventions aimed at preventing/reducing low energy availability in adolescent female athletes
records.study_design_sample: Scoping review of nutrition education interventions targeting low energy availability specifically in adolescent female athletes

records.title_en: The Practice of Weight Loss in Combat Sports Athletes: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 格鬥類運動員的減重實踐：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Observational synthesis of methods, magnitude, and frequency of weight-loss practices used by combat-sport athletes to make weight
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of weight-loss practices in weight-category combat sports (e.g., wrestling, judo, taekwondo, boxing) — not fencing

records.title_en: Patterns of Weight Cycling in Youth Olympic Combat Sports: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 青少年奧林匹克格鬥類運動中的體重循環模式：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Observational synthesis of weight-cycling frequency/methods among youth combat-sport athletes
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of weight-cycling patterns specifically in youth (adolescent) Olympic combat-sport athletes — not fencing

records.title_en: Prevalence of Disordered Eating in Athletes Categorized by Emphasis on Leanness and Activity Type: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 依體態強調程度與活動類型分類的運動員飲食失調盛行率：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: No intervention; pools prevalence estimates of disordered eating across leanness-emphasized vs. non-leanness sports
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of disordered-eating prevalence across athlete groups categorized by leanness emphasis and activity type

records.title_en: A Systematic Review, Meta-analysis, and Meta-regression of the Prevalence of Self-reported Disordered Eating and Associated Factors Among Athletes Worldwide
records.title_zh: 全球運動員自報飲食失調盛行率及相關因素之系統性回顧、元分析與元回歸
records.intervention_studied: No intervention; pools global prevalence data and regresses disordered-eating rates on moderators (sex, sport type, competition level, region)
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of self-reported disordered eating prevalence across a large global athlete sample

records.title_en: Energy and Macronutrients Intake in Indoor Sport Team Athletes: Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 室內團體運動員的熱量與巨量營養素攝取：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: No intervention; compares reported dietary intake in indoor team-sport athletes against sport-nutrition reference recommendations
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of energy/macronutrient intake studies in indoor team-sport athletes (basketball, handball, volleyball, futsal), mostly adult

records.title_en: Ergo-Nutritional Intervention in Basketball: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 篮球運動中的人體工學營養介入：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Various nutrition/ergogenic interventions (carbohydrate, protein, hydration strategies) tested in basketball players
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of nutrition/ergogenic-aid intervention studies in basketball players, predominantly adult

records.title_en: Practical Application and Methodological Considerations on the Basics of Sports Nutrition in Basketball: A Comprehensive Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 篮球基礎運動營養學的實務應用與方法學考量：全面性系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Reviews basketball-specific energy expenditure, macronutrient intake, and hydration studies; evaluates methodological quality of the field
records.study_design_sample: Comprehensive systematic review of observational and interventional basketball-nutrition studies

records.title_en: The Impact of Sleep Interventions on Athletic Performance: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 睡眠介入對運動表現的影響：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Sleep-extension, sleep-hygiene education, and napping interventions tested against athletic performance outcomes
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of sleep-intervention (extension, hygiene, napping) trials and their effect on athletic performance, mostly adult/collegiate athletes

records.title_en: Restoration of Muscle Glycogen and Functional Capacity: Role of Post-Exercise Carbohydrate and Protein Co-Ingestion
records.title_zh: 肌肌糖原與功能性容量的恢復：運動後碳水化合物與蛋白質共同攝取的角色
records.intervention_studied: Carbohydrate-only vs. carbohydrate+protein co-ingestion after exercise, effect on glycogen resynthesis rate and next-session capacity
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review of post-exercise glycogen resynthesis physiology and carbohydrate+protein co-ingestion trials, mostly adult

records.title_en: The Effect of Consuming Carbohydrate With and Without Protein on the Rate of Muscle Glycogen Re-synthesis During Short-Term Post-exercise Recovery: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
records.title_zh: 短期運動後恢復中，攝取碳水化合物搭配或不搭配蛋白質對肌肌糖原再合成速率的影響：系統性回顧與元分析
records.intervention_studied: Carbohydrate-only vs. carbohydrate+protein co-ingestion, pooled effect on glycogen resynthesis rate
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs comparing carbohydrate-only vs. carbohydrate+protein on short-term glycogen resynthesis, mostly adult trained males

records.title_en: Nutritional Strategies to Improve Post-exercise Recovery and Subsequent Exercise Performance: A Narrative Review
records.title_zh: 提升運動後彩復與後續運動表現的營養策略：敘述性回顧
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes evidence on carbohydrate/protein refeeding, fluid replacement, and sleep as recovery levers
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review synthesizing post-exercise recovery nutrition strategies (carbohydrate, protein, fluid, sleep) across the exercise-science literature, mostly adult

records.title_en: Carbohydrate Consumption and Periodization Strategies Applied to Elite Soccer Players
records.title_zh: 適用於頸尖足球選手的碳水化合物攝取與周期化策略
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes carbohydrate periodization approaches matched to soccer training/match load
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review of carbohydrate periodization research in elite (adult) soccer players

records.title_en: Weight Management for Athletes and Active Individuals: A Brief Review
records.title_zh: 運動員與活躍人口的體重管理：簡要回顧
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; reviews energy-deficit approaches, rate of weight loss, and preservation of lean mass/performance during weight management
records.study_design_sample: Brief narrative review of weight-management principles for athletes, mostly adult-derived

records.title_en: Youth Athlete Development and Nutrition
records.title_zh: 青少年運動員發展與營養
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes evidence and gaps specific to nutrition needs of growing/developing young athletes
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review specifically on nutrition for youth (child/adolescent) athletes across growth and development

records.title_en: Bone Health in Young Athletes: A Narrative Review of the Recent Literature
records.title_zh: 年輕運動員的骨骼健康：最新文獻的敘述性回顧
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; reviews calcium, vitamin D, and energy-availability influences on bone accrual and stress-injury risk in young athletes
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review of bone-health determinants (nutrition, training load, hormones) specifically in young/adolescent athletes

records.title_en: Nutrition and Athlete Bone Health
records.title_zh: 營養與運動員骨骼健康
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; reviews calcium, vitamin D, energy availability, and dietary patterns affecting bone mineral density and stress-fracture risk
records.study_design_sample: Comprehensive narrative review of nutrition-bone interactions across the athlete lifespan, predominantly adult data with some adolescent discussion

records.title_en: Caffeine Use in Sport: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Acute Side Effects and Implications for Athlete Health and Safety
records.title_zh: 運動中的咖啡因使用：急性副作用與對運動員健康與安全影響之系統性回顧與元分析
records.intervention_studied: Acute caffeine ingestion vs. placebo; pooled side-effect incidence (e.g., anxiety, GI distress, sleep disruption)
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of acute caffeine side-effect data pooled across sport/exercise trials, predominantly adult

records.title_en: Caffeinated Drinks and Physical Performance in Sport: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 含咖啡因飲品與運動表現：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Caffeinated beverages (coffee, energy drinks) vs. placebo, effect on strength/endurance/team-sport performance
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of caffeinated-drink trials and physical-performance outcomes, predominantly adult participants

records.title_en: Safety of Creatine Supplementation in Active Adolescents and Youth: A Brief Review
records.title_zh: 肌酸補充於活躍青少年與兒童中的安全性：簡要回顧
records.intervention_studied: Reviews the small existing body of pediatric/adolescent creatine trials for safety signals (renal, hepatic, growth)
records.study_design_sample: Brief review specifically on creatine safety in active adolescents/youth (rare adolescent-specific supplement-safety literature)

records.title_en: The Relationship between Vegetarian Diet and Sports Performance: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 素食與運動表現之關係：系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Vegetarian/vegan vs. omnivorous dietary patterns, compared for strength/endurance performance outcomes
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review comparing vegetarian/vegan vs. omnivorous diets and sports-performance outcomes, predominantly adult

records.title_en: The Effect of Diet and Dietary Supplements on Iron Status of Active Females: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Interventional Trials
records.title_zh: 飲食與飲食補充劑對活躍女性鐵質狀態的影響：介入性試驗之系統性回顧與元分析
records.intervention_studied: Dietary iron modification and/or iron supplementation, pooled effect on iron-status biomarkers (ferritin, hemoglobin) in active females
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of interventional trials on diet/supplement effects on iron status in active females

records.title_en: Optimizing Performance Nutrition for Adolescent Athletes: A Review of Dietary Needs, Risks, and Practical Strategies
records.title_zh: 優化青少年運動員的表現營養：飲食需求、風險與實務策略回顧
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; synthesizes adolescent-specific dietary needs, common risks (LEA, disordered eating), and practical intake strategies
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review specifically synthesizing adolescent athlete nutrition needs, risks, and practical strategies

records.title_en: Improved Physical Performance of Elite Soccer Players Based on GPS Results After 4 Days of Carbohydrate Loading Followed by 3 Days of Low Carbohydrate Diet
records.title_zh: 頸尖足球選手在 4 天碳水化合物載入後接着 3 天低碳飲食，其 GPS 數據所顯示的體能改善
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: 4 days carbohydrate loading followed by 3 days low-carbohydrate diet, vs. control diet, effect on GPS-tracked match physical performance
records.study_design_sample: Randomized controlled trial in elite adult male soccer players (small sample), GPS-tracked match performance

records.title_en: Iron Deficiency, Supplementation, and Sports Performance in Female Athletes: A Systematic Review
records.title_zh: 女性運動員的鐵質不足、補充與運動表現：系統性回顧
records.journal_organization: Journal of Sport and Health Science
records.intervention_studied: Iron supplementation vs. no supplementation/placebo in iron-deficient female athletes, effect on performance and iron biomarkers
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of iron deficiency, supplementation, and performance outcomes in female athletes, predominantly adult

records.title_en: Nutrition as a Missing Piece in the Development of Youth Male Soccer Players: A Scoping Review and Future Directions
records.title_zh: 營養作為青少年男性足球選手發展中缺失的一塊拼圖：範圍式回顧與未來方向
records.intervention_studied: No intervention; maps existing youth male soccer nutrition literature and identifies research gaps
records.study_design_sample: Scoping review of nutrition research specifically in youth (adolescent) male soccer players

records.title_en: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Carbohydrate Benefits Associated with Randomized Controlled Competition-based Performance Trials
records.title_zh: 碳水化合物在隨機對照比賽型表現試驗中益處之系統性回顧與元分析
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: Carbohydrate ingestion during exercise vs. placebo, pooled effect on competition-realistic performance trials
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs testing carbohydrate ingestion in competition-based performance trials, predominantly adult endurance athletes

records.title_en: Rethinking Energy Availability from Conceptual Models to Applied Practice: A Narrative Review
records.title_zh: 重新思考能量可用性：從概念模型到實務應用的敘述性回顧
records.intervention_studied: No new intervention; critiques and updates conceptual models of energy availability and their practical measurement/application
records.study_design_sample: Narrative/conceptual review of energy-availability models and their practical application, predominantly adult-derived

records.title_en: Measurement of Energy Intake Using the Principle of Energy Balance Overcomes a Critical Limitation in the Assessment of Energy Availability
records.title_zh: 運用能量平衡原則測量熱量攝取，克服能量可用性評估中的關鍵限制
records.intervention_studied: No new empirical intervention; proposes/validates an energy-balance method to estimate energy intake more accurately for energy-availability calculations
records.study_design_sample: Methodological/narrative review proposing an energy-balance-based approach to measuring energy intake for energy-availability assessment, adult (military/athlete) context

records.title_en: Acute and Residual Soccer Match-Related Fatigue: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
records.title_zh: 足球比賽相關的急性與殘留性疲勞：系統性回顧與元分析
records.intervention_studied: No intervention; pools time-course data on fatigue markers (strength, sprint, jump, biochemical) after competitive soccer matches
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of studies measuring acute and multi-day residual fatigue after soccer matches, predominantly adult/professional players

records.title_en: Recommendations and Nutritional Considerations for Female Athletes: Health and Performance
records.title_zh: 女性運動員的營養建議與考量：健康與表現
records.intervention_studied: Narrative synthesis of nutrition-related health risks in female athletes, including low energy availability, menstrual dysfunction, bone health, and iron status, with practical screening and management recommendations
records.study_design_sample: Narrative review (no primary sample; synthesizes RED-S, bone health, and iron literature in female athletes)

records.title_en: Effect of Plant Versus Animal Protein on Muscle Mass, Strength, Physical Performance, and Sarcopenia: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
records.title_zh: 植物性與動物性蛋白質對肌肉量、肌力、身體表現與肌少症影響之系統性回顧與統合分析
records.intervention_studied: Meta-analysis comparing plant-derived versus animal-derived dietary protein sources on muscle mass, strength, and physical performance outcomes across RCTs
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials comparing plant vs. animal protein sources

records.title_en: Effects of Omega-3 Supplementation on Inflammation and Recovery in Sports: A Meta-Analysis
records.title_zh: Omega-3補充對運動發炎與恢復影響之統合分析
records.intervention_studied: Meta-analysis of omega-3 fatty acid supplementation trials measuring inflammatory biomarkers and recovery-related outcomes after exercise
records.study_design_sample: Meta-analysis of controlled trials examining omega-3 fatty acid supplementation and inflammatory/recovery markers in athletic populations

records.title_en: Selected In-Season Nutritional Strategies to Enhance Recovery for Team Sport Athletes: A Practical Overview
records.title_zh: 團隊運動員賽季中促進恢復之營養策略：實務概覽
records.intervention_studied: Narrative synthesis of nutritional strategies (carbohydrate/protein timing, hydration, sleep-supportive nutrition) intended to enhance recovery between competitions during a team-sport season
records.study_design_sample: Practical/narrative review synthesizing recovery nutrition strategies for in-season team sport athletes (no primary sample)

records.title_en: Nutrition Education and Behavioral Interventions in Youth Team-Sport and Related Development Settings: A Systematic Review of Nutrition Knowledge, Dietary Behaviors, Hydration, Body Composition, and Performance
records.title_zh: 青少年團隊運動及相關發展情境中之營養教育與行為介入：營養知識、飲食行為、水分補充、身體組成與表現之系統性回顧
records.intervention_studied: Systematic review of school- and club-based nutrition education and behavioral intervention programs targeting youth team-sport athletes, assessing changes in nutrition knowledge, dietary behavior, hydration practices, body composition, and performance
records.study_design_sample: Systematic review of nutrition education / behavioral intervention studies in youth team-sport and youth development settings

records.title_en: General and Sport-Specific Nutrition Knowledge and Behaviors of Adolescent Athletes
records.title_zh: 青少年運動員之一般與專項營養知識與行為
records.journal_organization: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
records.intervention_studied: Cross-sectional survey measuring adolescent athletes' general sports-nutrition knowledge, sport-specific nutrition knowledge, and self-reported dietary behaviors, examining gaps between knowledge and practice
records.study_design_sample: Cross-sectional survey study of adolescent athletes assessing general and sport-specific nutrition knowledge and self-reported dietary behaviors

records.title_en: Physiological Responses and Energy Expenditure During Competitive Fencing
records.title_zh: 競技擊劍過程中的生理反應與能量消耗〔擊劍專項證據缺口記錄〕
records.intervention_studied: Physiological monitoring (heart rate, oxygen uptake, energy expenditure estimation) of fencers during competitive bouts; not a nutrition intervention study
records.study_design_sample: Small observational physiological-monitoring study of competitive fencers during simulated/actual bouts (n small, exact count not independently re-verified in this pass)
